data: Does the percentage of search errors without empty translations increase as source sentence length increases?

The red line represents the percentage of search errors with empty global bests, while the blue line represents the percentage of search errors without empty translations. The green line represents the percentage of search errors with empty global bests but without empty translations.

From the figure, we can see that the blue line (search errors without empty translations) consistently increases as the source sentence length increases. This is evident from the upward trend of the blue line across all the intervals shown in the x-axis. Therefore, the percentage of search errors without empty translations does indeed increase as the source sentence length increases.
Yes, the percentage of search errors without empty translations increases as the source sentence length increases.
